skill.name: ai-video-generation
skill.description: AI video generation for agents through Luxin's zero-setup hosted creative runtime. Use when a prompt should become a durable hosted video without provider credentials, OAuth, local runtime, or per-provider billing. Start with the no-spend guide, choose a video model, and keep model discovery, jobs, costs, URLs, JSON recovery, payments, and feedback in one loop.
skill.summary: Create hosted AI videos through Luxin with guided setup, spend controls, job recovery, and durable output links.
skill.author: danielgwilson

security_audit.summary: Several scanner hits are Markdown fences, inline identifiers, expected URLs, or workspace-local path references, so those are false positives. Commands that run unpinned npm packages or perform global skill installation are confirmed medium risks. The hosted workflow also sends prompts externally and may consume credits, requiring explicit consent.

remediation.issue: The examples execute unpinned npm packages and automatically accept installation prompts.
remediation.suggestion: Pin exact package versions, publish integrity information, and require confirmation before first execution.

remediation.issue: The installation examples modify global agent skill state.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer workspace-scoped installation and show the destination path before changing global state.

remediation.issue: Hosted generation can transmit prompts and consume shared credits.
remediation.suggestion: Request explicit approval before upload or spending, and display the destination, estimate, and retained job data.

content.user_title: Generate Hosted AI Videos with Luxin
content.value_statement: Managing video providers, credentials, billing, and job recovery creates operational overhead. This skill routes video requests through Luxin for guided creation, hosted outputs, cost limits, and recoverable jobs.
actual_capabilities: Guides text-to-video creation through the hosted Luxin command-line runtime.
Starts with a no-spend guide that reports readiness and missing inputs.
Supports model selection, prompts, intent settings, and estimated spending limits.
Produces durable hosted media links, recoverable jobs, and cost receipts through Luxin.
Provides installation commands, writable agent-state setup, contract links, and structured feedback guidance.
limitations: Requires network access and availability of Luxin, npm, and the selected video provider.
Example commands use mutable package versions and require additional trust before execution.
Video creation may consume Luxin credits and must follow user spending approval.
The skill provides a hosted command workflow, not a bundled local video model.

use_cases.title: Create Social Video Concepts
use_cases.description: Turn a short campaign concept into a hosted motion clip with a recorded job and cost receipt.

use_cases.title: Prototype Product Reveals
use_cases.description: Generate short product motion studies before committing to a full production workflow.

use_cases.title: Automate Recoverable Video Jobs
use_cases.description: Launch constrained video jobs, retain durable links, and recover status across agent sessions.

prompt_templates.title: Create a First Video
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a ten-second video of [subject] in [setting]. Use the guide first and do not spend credits without my approval.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner wants one guided text-to-video result.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Product Reveal
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a [duration] product reveal for [product]. Use [camera style], [lighting], and [aspect ratio]. Return the hosted link and cost receipt.
prompt_templates.scenario: A creator needs a controlled visual concept.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Video Models
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare suitable Luxin video models for [concept]. Run no-spend discovery first. Recommend one model with estimated cost, latency, and capability tradeoffs.
prompt_templates.scenario: A team needs model selection before spending credits.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Constrained Campaign Batch
prompt_templates.prompt: Create [number] variants for [campaign]. Enforce a maximum estimated spend of [amount]. Recover failed jobs and report links, receipts, and feedback identifiers.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced workflow needs multiple governed and recoverable jobs.

output_examples.input: Create a ten-second handheld product reveal, but do not spend credits yet.
output_examples.output: The guide selected the LTX video model and prepared the prompt. Creation remains paused until spending approval.

output_examples.input: Generate a cinematic city motion study with a maximum estimated spend of 0.25 USD.
output_examples.output: The job completed within the requested limit. The response includes a durable hosted video link, job reference, and cost receipt.

output_examples.input: Report a missing portrait-video capability after model discovery.
output_examples.output: The attempted command, expected result, actual result, and missing capability were prepared for hosted feedback submission.

best_practices: Run the no-spend guide before creation to confirm readiness, required inputs, and model availability.
Confirm content privacy, usage rights, and the spending limit before submitting prompts or assets.
Retain job references, hosted links, and cost receipts so later agents can recover the work.
anti_patterns: Do not run a suggested creation command when its copy-runnable flag is false.
Do not submit secrets, confidential prompts, or restricted assets without approval for hosted processing.
Do not execute mutable npm packages or global installations without reviewing provenance and destination paths.

faq.question: Does this skill require provider API keys?
faq.answer: No provider credentials are required. Luxin uses its hosted runtime and may use an optional restricted Luxin token.

faq.question: Can I inspect options without spending credits?
faq.answer: Yes. Start with the guide and recommended no-spend commands before authorizing creation.

faq.question: Where are generated videos stored?
faq.answer: Luxin returns durable hosted media links and recoverable job records rather than local model output.

faq.question: Can video generation incur charges?
faq.answer: Yes. Creation can consume Luxin credits, so approve the estimated limit before running a paid command.

faq.question: Does this skill run a local video model?
faq.answer: No. It uses Luxin's hosted runtime and depends on network access and external service availability.

faq.question: What happens when Luxin lacks a needed capability?
faq.answer: Use a fallback only for the missing gap, then submit structured feedback describing the command and result.
